subject: Bluestone AI renewal: term swap & 40% capacity uplift proposal
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@bluestoneai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bluestone AI renewal: term swap & 40% capacity uplift proposal

Hi Anna -

Thanks again for the time yesterday. I pulled together a concise plan to address the Q3 spike you flagged and to make the renewal motion simple from procurement/legal. Key facts from our side (90-day view):
- Current run rate: ~12.4M tokens/month (inference + embeddings).
- Peak window: sustained 2-week spike averaging +38% above baseline (approx 17.1M tokens/month).
- Committed tokens on the current contract: 10M tokens/month; overage pricing has started to accelerate costs over the last two cycles.

Proposed options (short-form):
A) Term swap (recommended): move from the current 12-month commitment to a 15-month term with a mid-term capacity uplift. You get: 40% uplift to committed capacity for months 4-6 (prorated), a 12% per-token price reduction on the uplifted tranche, and guaranteed priority routing during peak windows.
B) Burst credits + short uplift: keep the 12-month term, add a 3-month 40% burst credit pool (one-time fee) and a 6k USD implementation credit if you sign the amendment by June 7.

Financial snapshot (illustrative):
- Today: effective unit $0.00250/token on committed volume (10M).
- Option A (swap + uplift): uplifted committed volume = 14M/month for uplift months; unit drops to $0.00220/token on uplifted tranche. Estimated 12% savings on expected usage mix across uplift months.
- Option B (burst credits): one-time burst credit purchase = $16k (covers ~6M tokens at discounted burst rate); no term extension.

Attachments: I included a short Q3 usage report, a term_swap_summary.xlsx with month-by-month math, and an updated quote (redwood_quote_v3.pdf).

Ask: can you confirm which option procurement prefers? If Option A looks good, we can circulate the amendment + PO template and I can route the DocuSign to legal. If procurement needs a cap on total spend, we can include a hard cap + rollover credits clause as discussed.

Thanks - short bullets preferred.

Best,

-- Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
[Attachment: q3_usage_report.pdf (6 pages, PDF)]

From: Anna Ruiz <anna@bluestoneai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluestoneai.com
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Bluestone AI renewal: term swap & 40% capacity uplift proposal

Laura -

Appreciate the clear options. A few quick notes from procurement and finance:
- Budget window for Q3 is tight; we cannot increase committed spend without a corresponding cost offset or multi-quarter amortization.
- Legal will need a clean amendment that clearly states the uplift months, rollover terms, and whether unused uplift tokens convert to credits.
- We also need a short SOC2 / data handling note for the procurement package (our SRE will ask).

Attached is our internal forecast (we sent separately to Monica last week) - it shows the expected feature rollouts that drive the +38% demand. Procurement asked if Redwood can:
1) Offer Option A but spread the uplift cost across 6 months instead of front-loading it.
2) Provide a one-time implementation credit in lieu of a deeper unit price reduction (procurement prefers credits vs lower list pricing for budgeting).

If you can send an amendment draft and mark up the pricing spreadsheet with an amortized uplift scenario (6-month spread) we can run it through finance next week.

Anna Ruiz
Head of Product Ops | Bluestone AI
anna@bluestoneai.com
[Attachment: bluestone_internal_forecast.xlsx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@bluestoneai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, procurement@bluestoneai.com
Date: Thu, 31 May 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluestone AI renewal: term swap & 40% capacity uplift proposal

Thanks Anna - quick follow-up with the amortized alternative and next steps. See the inline math in term_swap_summary.xlsx (attached). Summary here so procurement can review quickly:

Amortized uplift (recommended alternate):
- Uplift profile: +40% committed capacity for months 4-6, cost of uplift prorated and spread across months 4-9 (6-month amortization).
- Net effect: no large one-time invoice in month 4; average monthly increase across months 4-9 = ~+11% to committed spend versus baseline.
- Implementation credit: Redwood will apply a one-time $8,000 credit against month 4 invoice if amendment is signed by June 7.
- Rollover: unused uplift tokens convert to a rollover credit at 60% of list price and must be used within the following 3 months.

Operational guarantees included in amendment:
- Priority routing for uplift tranche during defined business hours (06:00-22:00 PT).
- Token-level cost/latency dashboard access for Bluestone SREs (30-day retention) and an SLO note: p95 latency target preserved; p99 target monitored and escalated if breached 3x in a 7-day window.

Next steps (proposal):
1) We circulate a one-page amendment and redwood_quote_v3.pdf with the amortized math.
2) Legal/procurement confirm PO number and any procurement-specific verbiage.
3) We send DocuSign for signature - once signed, the first amortized uplift billing will begin the following billing cycle.

I've attached redwood_quote_v3.pdf and updated term_swap_summary.xlsx. If procurement is happy, I can drop a draft amendment into DocuSign this afternoon.

-- Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: term_swap_summary.xlsx]
[Attachment: redwood_quote_v3.pdf (3 pages, PDF)]

From: Anna Ruiz <anna@bluestoneai.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@bluestoneai.com
Date: Thu, 31 May 2028 14:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Bluestone AI renewal: term swap & 40% capacity uplift proposal

Laura -

This looks good and aligns with the internal ask. Procurement confirmed they prefer the amortized uplift + $8k implementation credit vs a permanent list price change. Please proceed with:
- Amendment draft + markups to the SOW for priority routing hours.
- DocuSign for Bluestone (PO will be issued after signature; PO number to follow within 24-48 hours).
- Add a short SOC2 attestation page to the paperwork for legal - our SREs will validate but it helps speed things up.

If you can get the DocuSign over today, we'll aim to return the signed amendment by early next week.

Thanks - Anna
Head of Product Ops | Bluestone AI
